speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health given the rising incidence of cancer detection in Singapore, whether there are plans to increase the availability and uptake of screening for common types of cancer in Singapore, such as lung, liver and prostate cancer.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: I think cancer screening under Healthier SG is an excellent programme and the earlier you detect, the better.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: I had recommended a few specific types of cancer in my question.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: To follow up, the first question I have is, for those who are at higher risk, will their screenings be subsidised by the Government?

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: Second, what is the view on multi-cancers screening tests?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: What we recommend is for patients to have that good relationship with their doctors so that they can individually recommend it accordingly.
